summary: scripts/evidence-flip-ready derives each aggregate check's skipped members from data the gate already uses (the policy marks the aggregate; the members are the workflow jobs that read its gate's skip output), replacing the hand-kept list, and reports an aggregate's red as superseded_red, not a hidden red, when a newer push replaced the run: the run concluded cancelled, none of those members failed and at least one was cancelled, and a run of a different head on the same branch was created before the first of them was cancelled. A timeout, a cancel with no newer run, or a failed member stays a hidden red; a red of a member that always runs (upgrade-impact, fractal-web-changes) stays visible. fractal-web is now read as the aggregate it is, and linux-gate's members gain mail-redelivery-canaries, whose steps read its skip output.

replay.detail: A read-only helper script that reports when a check's flip trigger holds; no skip policy, workflow, gate, verifier, protocol, schema or CLI change.

rules.detail: Changes only which reds evidence-flip-ready counts as hidden when it decides whether a check's flip trigger holds (for example fractal-web after a push cancelled a run); no skip policy or gate rule changes.
